accessibility.title: Accessibility access needed
accessibility.fix: Allow dictate in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility.

noSamples.title: No sound from the microphone
noSamples.fix: Check it in Settings → General → Test microphone.

missingModel.title: Speech model missing
missingModel.fix: Download a speech model in Settings › Models.

whisperMissing.title: whisper-cli not found
whisperMissing.fix: Run `brew install whisper.cpp` in Terminal, then try again.
